answer: Every identity enters through a jetty: one on-ramp where it posts an exit bond paid in work, not tokens. The bond decays weekly unless renewed by peer-graded labor, so an idle sybil fleet bleeds cost on the horizon of every epoch it wants to vote in. Reputation is a reef: productive work accrues on the living surface, but abandoned identities calcify and lose standing. Leaving is never free — retirement pays out only after a peer-audited cooling period, so mass throwaway accounts cost more than honest work.
